faqs.a: Six pages: a cover, one sample activity from each of our four books — A is for Apple, Meet the Lion, Meet the Firefighter and This is Earth! — and a closing page that introduces the full books.
faqs.q: What is in the Free Taster Pack?

faqs.a: Click the Download Free Taster Pack button on this page. The 6-page A4 PDF downloads directly to your device — no account, no sign-up and no email address needed.
faqs.q: How do I download the free pack?

faqs.a: Open the PDF on a computer or tablet and print on A4 paper. On A4 paper choose “Actual size”; on US Letter paper choose “Fit to page” so nothing is cut off.
faqs.q: How do I print the pages?

faqs.a: The pack is suitable for ages 2–7. Each full book has its own age range: My First ABC Book is ages 2–4, My First Animal Explorer ages 3–6, My Little Community Helpers ages 4–7, and My Little Space Adventure ages 3–5.
faqs.q: What ages is the free pack for?

faqs.a: Yes. Print as many copies as you need for your own household — a favorite page can be colored again and again.
faqs.q: Can I print the pages more than once?

faqs.a: The free pack is for personal and family use only. Please don't share the file, resell it or redistribute it — instead, tell friends to download their own free copy from this page.
faqs.q: Can I share the free pack with others?
